gist: Items lent to friends and returned. Returned and closed: tent to Jonah, back 1 Jun [n1360]; slow cooker to Vik, back 12 Jun [n1831], and to Wren, back 1 Jul [n1834]; projector to Elif, back 7 Jul [n1339]; Northern Lights to Jo Farrow, back 31 Jul [n1353]; board game to Hugo, back 31 Jul [n1350]; camping stove to Quinn, back 30 Jul [n1695]; ladder to Pia, back 14 Aug [n1692]. Still open: sewing machine with Leo, task to get it back [n1842]; tent with Jo, task open [n1843]; drill lent to Omar with no return recorded [n1681]; camping stoves lent to Elif Tamsin [n1341] and Maya [n1575] with no return recorded. Suspicious: a ladder return from Quinn Kowal on 4 Oct [n1698] matches no loan, and several names vary (Jonah, Jo, Quinn).
